parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is a small lever or handle made of stainless steel, used to control the water flow and temperature of the faucet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt around a pivot axis to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main cylindrical body of the faucet made of stainless steel, providing structural support and housing internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the faucet to the sink and contains the internal water channels and valve mechanisms.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the base for other moving parts like the switch and spout.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the elongated curved tube made of stainless steel through which water exits the faucet.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of water from the faucet to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
